explanation: The theorem is a naturality square for Spec.map along a commutative square of ring homomorphisms involving the library-specific definitions `barPt A` (defined in `Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_JZeroNeronObjectAtP.lean` as `Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom A.subtype)`) and `A4Tor.decAut` (the MulSemiringAction ring hom of an element of the decomposition subgroup, defined locally in the same file as the theorem), together with the local lemma `subtype_comp_decAut`. It is purely about the library's own objects; the only Mathlib ingredients used (`Spec.map_comp`, `CommRingCat.ofHom_comp`) are general functoriality facts with no such statement in Mathlib. Searching Mathlib for `barPt`, `decAut`, `subtype_comp_decAut`, `decompositionSubgroup`-related statements yielded nothing corresponding, so no Mathlib declaration states this result, and it is not an instance of a single Mathlib lemma (its statement cannot even be formulated without the library's definitions of `barPt` and `decAut`).
